entities.summary: Leader of Slovenia (1992–2002 (PM), 2002–2007 (President)). Liberal Democrats; longest-serving PM; EU accession negotiator; President: eccentric final years (moved to mountain, spiritual awakening, unconventional); died 2008; architect of modern Slovenia
